close_disposition.replacement_of walks duplicates(outbound)/supersedes(inbound) — a replacement is typically OUTSIDE the descendant subtree
findings.finding: The plan adds 'replacement/superseding tickets' to the accepted-id set without reasoning about their interaction with _union_file_impact and _check_file_impact_vs_diff. A duplicate/superseded replacement is an unrelated ticket implementing different work; unioning it into accepted_ids means its file_impact and commit diffs are validated against THIS epic's declared paths, producing either a false pass or a spurious 'work went beyond the reviewed plan' block.
findings.location: RCA Plan step 3 ('any replacement/superseding tickets recorded by administrative close dispositions')
scenarios: Epic closed while a child was dispositioned duplicate → replacement's commits touch replacement-owned paths not in the epic's file_impact → _check_file_impact_vs_diff blocks with 'beyond the reviewed plan', or credits an unrelated commit as this epic's landed work

findings.finding: The plan's central theory — that the accepted-id set 'still' omits transitive descendants OR replacement tickets — is only half-accurate against the code, and it under-specifies which. `_resolved_completion_scope` ALREADY unions transitive descendants (`{resolved_id} ∪ list_descendants`, the ferric-jet-scorpion fix). What it does NOT do is consult replacement/superseding links (`close_disposition.replacement_of`). The plan should state that descendants are already credited and scope the fix precisely to replacement/superseding tickets, or its RED test and fix may re-target work that already landed.
findings.location: RCA Plan step 3 ("Trace the accepted-id set built for an epic: own id, transitive descendants, and any replacement/superseding tickets")
scenarios: An executor writes a RED test crediting a grandchild descendant commit (already passes today) instead of a replacement-ticket commit, and 'fixes' a path that already works while the real replacement-ticket gap remains.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword step 3 to: 'The accepted-id set (`_resolved_completion_scope`) already covers own id + transitive descendants; extend it (or the landing check) to also credit commits referencing replacement/superseding tickets named by descendants' administrative-disposition links, resolved via `close_disposition.replacement_of`.'
